attempts.text: {"inventedFacts":[{"span":"found dead on his dock","reason":"Briefing says only that he was killed at his camp; no dock is mentioned."},{"span":"murdered by an unknown assailant","reason":"The briefing does not say who killed him or whether the killer is unknown."},{"span":"war parties are mobilizing against syndicate outposts in the north sector","reason":"No mobilization, outposts or north sector appear in the briefing."},{"span":"since the last patrol","reason":"The briefing mentions no patrol."}],"voice":2,"clarity":2,"tone":2,"overall":1,"comment":"It breaks the format with a title, bullet headings and markdown, and invents several details (dock, unknown assailant, north sector mobilization).
